From c78c3644b772e356ca452ae733a3c4de0fb11dc8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alan Stern <stern@rowland.harvard.edu>
Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2024 10:33:48 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] usb: Fix regression caused by invalid ep0 maxpacket in
 virtual SuperSpeed device

A virtual SuperSpeed device in the FreeBSD BVCP package
(https://bhyve.npulse.net/) presents an invalid ep0 maxpacket size of 256.
It stopped working with Linux following a recent commit because now we
check these sizes more carefully than before.

Fix this regression by using the bMaxpacketSize0 value in the device
descriptor for SuperSpeed or faster devices, even if it is invalid.  This
is a very simple-minded change; we might want to check more carefully for
values that actually make some sense (for instance, no smaller than 64).

Signed-off-by: Alan Stern <stern@rowland.harvard.edu>
Reported-and-tested-by: Roger Whittaker <roger.whittaker@suse.com>
Closes: https://bugzilla.suse.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1220569
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-usb/9efbd569-7059-4575-983f-0ea30df41871@suse.com/
Fixes: 59cf44575456 ("USB: core: Fix oversight in SuperSpeed initialization")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/4058ac05-237c-4db4-9ecc-5af42bdb4501@rowland.harvard.edu
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/usb/core/hub.c b/drivers/usb/core/hub.c
index 9446660e231b..008053039875 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/core/hub.c
+++ b/drivers/usb/core/hub.c
@@ -5110,9 +5110,10 @@ hub_port_init(struct usb_hub *hub, struct usb_device *udev, int port1,
 	}
 	if (usb_endpoint_maxp(&udev->ep0.desc) == i) {
 		;	/* Initial ep0 maxpacket guess is right */
-	} else if ((udev->speed == USB_SPEED_FULL ||
+	} else if (((udev->speed == USB_SPEED_FULL ||
 				udev->speed == USB_SPEED_HIGH) &&
-			(i == 8 || i == 16 || i == 32 || i == 64)) {
+			(i == 8 || i == 16 || i == 32 || i == 64)) ||
+			(udev->speed >= USB_SPEED_SUPER && i > 0)) {
 		/* Initial guess is wrong; use the descriptor's value */
 		if (udev->speed == USB_SPEED_FULL)
 			dev_dbg(&udev->dev, "ep0 maxpacket = %d\n", i);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/usb/core/hub.c`**
   - The conditional check for the initial guess of the `ep0` maxpacket size has been modified.
   - The new condition allows for the use of the descriptor's `bMaxpacketSize0` value for SuperSpeed or faster devices, even if it is invalid.
   - The specific change involves adding a new condition to the existing `else if` statement:
     - The original check for Full and High speed devices remains, but now it also includes a check for SuperSpeed devices where the maxpacket size (`i`) is greater than 0.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `hub.c` directly addresses a regression issue caused by a previous commit that enforced stricter checks on the `ep0` maxpacket size for SuperSpeed devices.
- By allowing the use of potentially invalid `bMaxpacketSize0` values for SuperSpeed devices, the patch aims to restore functionality for virtual SuperSpeed devices that were affected by the stricter validation introduced in the earlier commit.
- This change is a temporary fix, as the author notes that further validation of the maxpacket size may be necessary in the future to ensure that the values make sense (e.g., not smaller than 64).
